name: Full Smile
verdict: Over the past 28 days, Full Smile generated 122 leads at a $11.90 CPL entirely through Meta, with the top campaign "BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness" accounting for $749.85 of the $1,452.32 in spend. The biggest movement this week was a 32.93% drop in spend, which likely drove the 9.37% decline in leads, while CPL actually improved by 25.99%, suggesting the remaining budget is converting more efficiently.

performance.verdict: CPL efficiency is real, but spend collapse and 3 overdue SOW blockers threaten August scoreboard.

findings.text: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) still open — leads cannot be traced to calls, breaking the patient-to-chair scoreboard.
Sync items + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) still open — 122 leads in 28 days cannot be reliably matched to GHL opps without clean records.

Spend dropped -32.93% week-over-week to $40.84/day; CPL improved to ~$11.90, but 3-day lead signal (Aug 15–17: 1, 3, 8) is volatile and low vs prior 3 days (Aug 12–14: 8, 4, 1 avg 4.3). Volume risk is real.
GHL shows 82 opportunities created vs 122 leads — 40-lead gap and 0 appointments logged suggest an intake leak, not an ads problem.
GBP actions hit 25 on 2026-08-14 then dropped to 0 for 3 consecutive days (Aug 15–17) — organic floor may be eroding heading into prove-it month.

suggestions.text: Close phone-match attribution gap immediately — 40-lead intake leak makes August scoreboard unreadable without it.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution task was due 2026-08-07 and remains open. Of 122 leads generated in 28 days, only 82 appear as GHL opportunities — a 40-lead gap that cannot be diagnosed without call-to-lead matching. The fix closes the gap between Meta leads and patient-to-chair tracking, which is the client's explicit scoreboard for August renewal. Success check: all inbound calls from GHL tracking numbers are matched to a contact and opportunity in GHL by 2026-08-21.

suggestions.text: Complete sync + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14, overdue) — 0 appointments in GHL vs active lead volume confirms records are still unreliable.
suggestions.monday_update: The sync items and contact cleanup milestone due 2026-08-14 is not marked complete. GHL currently shows 0 appointments against 122 leads and 82 opportunities in the 28-day window, which means the pipeline data the client sees is not trustworthy. Complete the duplicate-contact resolution and appointment sync verification so that leads arriving from Meta correctly flow into GHL opportunities with appointment status. Success check: at least one confirmed appointment visible in GHL pipeline by 2026-08-22, with zero duplicate contacts created in the prior 7-day window.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta daily spend vs leads through 2026-08-21 — $40.84/day is thin for August prove-it volume at $11.90 CPL.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has fallen -32.93% week-over-week to $40.84/day. CPL improved to $11.90, which is efficient, but 3-day lead output (Aug 15–17: 1, 3, 8) is too volatile to confirm a trend. With August as a prove-it month, volume matters alongside efficiency. Do not scale yet — re-check the 3-day lead average on 2026-08-21. If the average holds at 5+ leads/day at CPL ≤ $13, bring a budget-increase recommendation to Sohib for approval.
